subject: Re: Eligibility for bundled listing & co-sell routing (GCP + Azure)
messages:
From: Nik Patel <nik.patel@cloudbridge.io>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Co-sell + bundled SKU: CloudBridge x Redwood — eligibility questions

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for walking through the high-level plan yesterday. CloudBridge is excited about packaging a joint offer (Redwood inference hosted + CB managed integration) into a single marketplace bundle. Before we invest in the productized integration, the partner success team needs to confirm a few things for GCP and Azure co-sell eligibility: 

- Does Redwood have an active partner listing in the GCP Marketplace with lead routing enabled?
- For a bundled SKU, do you (Redwood) manage the billing seat and revenue share, or should we set up a reseller flow?
- Any compliance artifacts we need (SOC2 cert, DPA language) to be included in the listing metadata?

Quick ask: can you share the internal checklist and the typical timeline for getting co-sell approval on GCP? Our timeline is tight — aiming for a joint announcement in mid-Jan.

Best,
Nik
Nik Patel
Head of Partnerships — CloudBridge
nik.patel@cloudbridge.io

Attachment: proposed-bundle-outline.pdf (see section 2)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Nik Patel <nik.patel@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-sell + bundled SKU: CloudBridge x Redwood — eligibility questions

Nik — really appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up-front, details below: 

1) GCP listing / lead routing: Yes — Redwood has an active GCP listing and can enable lead routing to CloudBridge via partner routing rules. We’ll need the partner routing email and the Partner ID for the partner registry.

2) Billing model: We typically support two patterns for bundled SKUs: 
   - Redwood-managed billing (Redwood invoices customer; revenue share to partner) — faster to market but requires our finance approval.
   - Reseller model (partner invoices and manages P&L) — preferred by some ISVs that own customer relationships.

3) Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 Type II, DPA, and a short security summary are required for all marketplace listings. For Azure co-sell there is an additional MSA addendum we can share.

Attached is our internal "co-sell_bundle_checklist.xlsx" with the items we use for GCP/Azure submissions. I highlighted the fields you should complete in the blue tab (partner contact, logos, sample customer references, lead routing email, reseller vs managed billing choice).

Timeline: If we get the completed checklist + one customer reference by Dec 10, Redwood can submit the GCP listing update and request co-sell routing; GCP review is typically 2–3 weeks. Azure can run in parallel but often requires the reseller agreement to be finalized for co-sell sign-off.

Next steps: Could you fill the blue tab and return by Dec 6? Also confirm whether CloudBridge prefers Redwood-managed billing or reseller flow. If you prefer reseller, loop in your finance/legal contact and I’ll bring our contracts team.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner Program Manager | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment: co-sell_bundle_checklist.xlsx

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Co-sell + bundled SKU: CloudBridge x Redwood — eligibility questions

All — quick internal alignment. If CloudBridge wants Redwood-managed billing for the bundle, we need purchase order and revenue-share terms approved by finance. Laura, can you advise on the minimal terms for a 12-month pilot revenue share (we're targeting 80/20 net to Redwood for the first 50 customers)? Also note: GCP requires a partner agreement amendment if the partner will receive routed leads; legal needs the Partner ID and routing email.

Karthik — can you check if there's any special SKU naming restrictions for multi-provider bundles? We should avoid duplicative SKUs across GCP and Azure. Also flag any catalog taxonomy constraints — I can sync with the partner registry contact if needed.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai; camila_reyes@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; Nik Patel <nik.patel@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-sell + bundled SKU: CloudBridge x Redwood — eligibility questions

Nik / team — I reviewed the proposed revenue share and pilot terms. A few legal/ops clarifications before we proceed: 

- For Redwood-managed billing with revenue share, we require a short revenue share addendum (non-negotiable clauses: tax handling, payment cadence net-30, minimum reporting fields). I can draft a one-page addendum and push for sign-off quickly.
- For reseller flow, we need CloudBridge's reseller certificate and a signed reseller schedule attached to the Marketplace Listing.
- Partner ID + partner routing email are essential for GCP lead routing; please provide both.

Action items I need from CloudBridge by Dec 8 to keep the mid-Jan announcement: 
1) Confirm billing model (managed vs reseller)
2) Provide Partner ID and routing email
3) One customer reference (name + contact) willing to be listed on the marketplace entry
4) Logo assets (SVG) and a short 50–75 word product blurb

Once we have those, I’ll prepare the addendum (if managed billing) and coordinate with Finance for a pilot revenue-share PO. Happy to join a 30-minute call if you prefer to run through items live.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
